text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I won.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I won――I was victorious
in that Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I have finally become a princess—...!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAYYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess! Kawakami Princess takes first place!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess dashes toward the winner's circle, her entire body brimming with joy—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Look, please look! I took 1st place!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I took 1st place in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
just as I had always dreamed!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Kawakami--!!
You did it, that was a fantastic race!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Do you have any idea what you just did?!
My girl almost tripped and fell just now!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I'd heard the rumors, but she really is a brute!
What kind of runner acts like that?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Look over here! Kawakami Princess!
That was an amazing race!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's head over to the victory interview
once again! Taking a glorious 1st place,
here is Kawakami Princess!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
How does it feel?
The thrill of the moment you claimed the glorious throne of the queen!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-It definitely felt like a dream!
I was so happy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's why, without thinking, I—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, so that girl is this year's Queen.
She was just running over to the circle a moment ago..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I'd heard the rumors, but she really is a brute!
What kind of runner acts like that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you keeping quiet?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho-san!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice with a big 'whoa~' like you always do!
It's not like you to just shut up and say nothing.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't think your drive during the race
was bad at all, so—

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so this year's Queen is buddies with that troublemaker?
Haaah... I see, she sounds like a real handful.

text_block_list.name: Madam Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Did you see her right after the finish line?
What an astonishing roar that was.
And on such an elegant stage, too.

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... even with 'Princess' in her name,
she's far from a queen, let alone acting like a princess."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (...Could I always hear voices like this?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(I wanted to become a princess like in PreFie.
I even won the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, but...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah! Princess-!
Blow them away next time too-!! You've got this-!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
What is with that girl... I really can't believe it.
She doesn't act like a princess at all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(In Pre-Fi's races,
everyone was smiling, but... what about me?)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where on earth do you think you're going?!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Uh... well! She must be completely overwhelmed
with emotion! What a fantastic, heated race!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The figure I once admired—was it truly meant to be like this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night. Even though Kawakami Princess had won
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup she had long dreamed of,
she was surprisingly "quiet."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I-It is nothing at all!
Ho-ho-ho! Now then, what shall
our next goal be!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This race came right on the heels of the Shuka Sho.
So after giving her some rest, I want to
tackle the Senior year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a turf middle-distance GⅡ. Held in March,
no matter which GⅠ she wishes to enter
during the spring GⅠ season, we should be able to accommodate it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...S-Sounds wonderful!
The name sounds, well, quite fun too.
Now then, for our next training session..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Displayed on the smartphone screen was the name of the TV producer who had helped us out before the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so sorry to contact you so late at night!
Actually, keeping this a secret from Kawakami Princess-san, I have an urgent matter I'd like to discuss with you, Trainer-san..."

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
"...Is she by any chance with you right now?
If so, I am terribly sorry, but—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah. I-I am perfectly fine!
I shall wait right here!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-No!
Not in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle...)

text_block_list.name: Prifight Character A
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible, Princess!!
As expected of the legendary warrior, the hope of everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... even with 'Princess' in her name,
she's far from a queen, let alone acting like a princess."

text_block_list.name: Prifight Character B
text_block_list.text:
" 'Look at PreFie's graceful demeanor!
Such an elegant figure that captivates everyone!' "

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I'd heard the rumors, but she really is a brute!
What kind of runner acts like that?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...No, no! Princess!
Why are you hanging your head?! All we need to do is be careful next time—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! ...Hmph! Take that!
Haa! Yah!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Deeeeeeeeeyah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(CRASH-BASH-CLATTER!!
FLAP-FLAP-FLAP-FLAP!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Nowah!? Eep, the cardboard box!?
The documents are falling!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah-wa-wa... I have to put it back
before Trainer gets back—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Is this...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Trainer!
My, what has gotten you in such a fluster?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Geez, nothing escapes this princess's eyes!
Though I'll pretend I didn't see anything for now♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think you'd prepare a surprise gift
for when I win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup♪
As expected of my Trainer, how stylish of you♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That surprise present...
you had with you before, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Glances around)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, excuse me.
Please let me borrow some energy in advance."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
When I receive it later,
I'll act like I didn't know and be happy, I promise...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Letters? Addressed to me and Trainer...?
There are so many... even more than the fan mail
I usually get..."
